name: trying to sleep
description: A sense that you should be sleeping, but are struggling to do so.
perceptions: Something is preventing me from sleeping.

guidance.description: Here are some articles that may help prepare yourself for a better night's rest.

commentaries.quote: Anything seems possible at night when the rest of the world has gone to sleep.
Before you sleep, read something that is exquisite, and worth remembering.
Without enough sleep, we all become tall two-year-olds.
You know you're in love when you can't fall asleep because reality is finally better than your dreams.
The night is the hardest time to be alive and 4am knows all my secrets.

Paying attention to sleep hygiene is one of the most straightforward ways that you can set yourself up for better sleep. Strong sleep hygiene means having both a bedroom environment and daily routines that promote consistent, uninterrupted sleep.
commentaries.attribution: Eric Suni and David Rosen, MD
